data.name: Mahika
data.gender_notes: Mahika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Mahika is derived from the word Mah, meaning 'great'. The suffix -ka denotes power or energy. In Hindu mythology, Mahika is the name of a goddess representing great power and energy. The name Mahika carries the meaning “Great Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahika usually hope their child will grow to embody great power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mahika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahika total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
